stem: Based on this excerpt and your knowledge of U.S. history, why did Benjamin Franklin believe in the importance of freedom of speech?

options.label: A
options.text: Because it helps prevent government tyranny

options.label: B
options.text: Because it helps promote an industrial society

options.label: C
options.text: Because it helps promote government unity

options.label: D
options.text: Because it helps prevent a divided society

visual_elements: Freedom of speech is a principal pillar of a free government; when this support is taken away, the constitution of a free society is dissolved. —Benjamin Franklin, Pennsylvania Gazette, November 1737
